english.note: This is the all-purpose command to urge a horse or other animal forward or faster.

exampleSentences.english: The carter shouted “gee,” and the horse immediately went faster.
exampleSentences.traditional: 馬夫大喝一聲「駕」，匹馬即刻跑快啲。
